analytical_question: How do conditional test-band predictions from the original start compare with a start chosen solely by the training objective, for every predetermined case?
takeaway: ID57 includes a worsening case and a large improvement; GroEL pairs nearly coincide under the tested local perturbations. A pooled improvement headline is omitted.
variant: Faceted paired-point comparison by case, dataset and fixed lambda
renderer: Matplotlib standalone scientific PNG and SVG

data_sufficiency.case_filter: None beyond the prospectively fixed control cases; no score selection

metric: Mean squared log1p prediction-minus-observation residual on full-resolution conditional test bands; dimensionless
start_selection: Minimum training-subsample objective with inherited lambda; no validation or test-based selection
palette_policy: hard two-root cap: blue reference and orange training-selected; neutral connectors/grid
non_color_distinction: Open squares for reference, filled circles for training-selected; direct signed changes on focal ID57 cases
axis_policy: Focused point-comparison y scales; identical ranges within each dataset and lambda pair. These are paired dots, not zero-baseline bars.
delivery: SI figure inserted at 6.27 inch width; standalone PNG/SVG are final QA surfaces
scope: Local perturbations only with original template classes, seed orientations and alignment retained; no global search or structural-identifiability claim
